name: Chainblade — edge chase
notes:
Derived from the revised AI-generated sheet, matching the supplied reference with requested edits. Automatically reduced grid interpretation; small details differ from the reference. Grip/pivot/muzzle are initial estimates requiring rig checks. Preview slot W07 confirmed from repository pixelkit-v2 manifest at ae7247a9b94aeb834342cd40e8aea2eb82308bb8. This does not add firing behaviours.
Revision: weapons-v001. Status: draft. Pixel cleanup and anchor/scale review outstanding. Stored in isolated art/weapon-lab branch.

Weapon-lighting-v001: Magenta energy chases along the blade edges; the original drive core breathes. 40 frames at 20 fps; 2s loop. Anchors, dimensions, body silhouette, scale, trim/guts unchanged. New lamp seats affect 10 body pixels inside the existing silhouette. Existing emissive colours preserved. Draft: in-game visibility and exact art approval pending. No geometry, articulated motion, firing trigger or 2x density changes.

Anchor-alignment-v001: calibrated handle grip and muzzle for the enlarged weapon rig. Body and all animation layers unchanged. Runtime scales around the grip; ranged shots use the transformed muzzle. Scale remains 1.2. Pending alignment verification.
